arabic text:
NA LEJA ZULJANA BABA KO
TU MUJHKO JUDA KER NA UNSE
AUR DAAGHE YATIMI MUJHKO NA DE
SAKINA’S PLEA TO ZULJANA
english translation text: DON’T TAKE MY FATHER AWAY FROM ME, OH ZULJANAH\nSEPARATE US NOT, DON’T LET ME BE ORPHANED

arabic text: DEKHA HE SAHAR SE YE MANZAR JO RANKO GAYA PHIR NA AYA\nSAKINA’S PLEA TO ZULJANA
english translation text: I HAVE WITNESSED A SCENE SINCE DAWN, WHERE ANYONE THAT HAS GONE TO FIGHT HAS NOT RETURNED

arabic text: SAB QATL HUE KOI NA RAHA BAQI HAI YAHI ABTO SAYA\nAUR DAAGHE YATIMI MUJHKO NA DE\nSAKINA’S PLEA TO ZULJANA
english translation text: DON’T LET ME BE ORPHANED\nALL OF THEM WERE KILLED, NO ONE REMAINS. HE IS MY ONLY REMAINING GUARDIAN.

arabic text: PAANI KA BAHAANA KERKE GAYE, ABBAS CHACHA DARIYA PE RAHE\nSAKINA’S PLEA TO ZULJANA
english translation text: USING THE PRETEXT OF FETCHING WATER, HE WENT, YET REMAINED AT THE STREAM

arabic text: AMMU KI TARHA KYU KARTA HAI, TU MUJHSE JUDA BABA KO MERE\nAUR DAAGHE YATIMI MUJHKO NA DE\nSAKINA’S PLEA TO ZULJANA
english translation text: DON’T LET ME BE ORPHANED\nDON’T FOLLOW IN MY UNCLE’S FOOTSTEPS, SEPARATE US NOT.

arabic text: QADMON MEI TERE SER MAINE RAKHA, ROTI HU BOHOT MUJHKO NA RULA\nSAKINA’S PLEA TO ZULJANA
english translation text: I HAVE PUT MY HEAD AT YOUR FEET, I HAVE CRIED ENOUGH ALREADY, DO NOT MAKE IT WORSE

arabic text: KYU LEKE CHALA TALWARON ME, BABA KO MERE KYA YE HAI WAFA\nAUR DAAGHE YATIMI MUJHKO NA DE\nSAKINA’S PLEA TO ZULJANA
english translation text: DON’T LET ME BE ORPHANED\nWHY DO YOU TAKE MY FATHER INTO THE MIDST OF SWORDS AND DAGGERS? IS THIS LOYALTY?

arabic text: KYA AKBER O ASGHER HURE JHARI, KYA AUN O MOHAMED AUR GHAAZI\nSAKINA’S PLEA TO ZULJANA
english translation text: AKBAR, ASGHAR AND HUR THE BRAVE, AUN-O-MOHAMMAD AND GHAZI ABBAS

arabic text: KHUD DEKHLE JAAKAR KHEIME MEI, SAB QATL HUWE AI ASPE JARI\nAUR DAAGHE YATIMI MUJHKO NA DE\nSAKINA’S PLEA TO ZULJANA
english translation text: DON’T LET ME BE ORPHANED\nGO SEE FOR YOURSELF IN THE TENTS, ALL OF THEM SLAIN.

arabic text: EHSAN TERA HOGA HUM PER, ZAHRA BHI DUA DEGHI TUJHKO\nSAKINA’S PLEA TO ZULJANA
english translation text: SHOW ME SOME KINDNESS, ZAHRA WILL PRAY IN YOUR FAVOUR

arabic text: BABA KO BACHALE MARNE SE, SAIDANI HU MEI SAIDANI\nAUR DAAGHE YATIMI SE MUJHKO NA DE\nSAKINA’S PLEA TO ZULJANA
english translation text: DON’T LET ME BE ORPHANED\nSAVE MY FATHER FROM DYING. I AM FROM THE HOUSE OF THE PROPHET.

arabic text: ZAKHMI HAI BOHOT MERA BABA, HAI DHOOP BOHOT AUR GHARM HAWA\nSAKINA’S PLEA TO ZULJANA
english translation text: MY FATHER IS VERY WOUNDED. THE SUN IS BRIGHT AND THE AIR IS HOT

arabic text: YE BAAT TO BHI JAANTA HAI, DO GUT INHE PAANI NA MILA\nAUR DAAGHE YATIMI SE MUJHKO NA DE\nSAKINA’S PLEA TO ZULJANA
english translation text: DON’T LET ME BE ORPHANED\nYOU KNOW THIS WELL, HE DIDN’T EVEN GET A SINGLE SIP OF WATER

arabic text: ABBAS KAMAR KO TOR GAYE, MAZLUM KO TANHA CHOR GAYE\nSAKINA’S PLEA TO ZULJANA
english translation text: ABBAS’ DEPARTURE BROKE HIS BACK AND LEFT HIM STRANDED AND ALONE

arabic text: THE JITNE FIDAAI BABA KE, BABA KO TADAP TA CHOR GAYE\nAUR DAAGHE YATIMI SE MUJHKO NA DE\nSAKINA’S PLEA TO ZULJANA
english translation text: DON’T LET ME BE ORPHANED\nFOR ALL THE MEN WHO CAME WITH US, DIED AND LEFT HIM ALONE AND RESTLESS
